steps.en: Install the package into your Worker project
steps.zh: 在你的 Worker 项目里安装这个包

steps.en: Wrap your Durable Object with the workspace mixin and declare the DO binding in wrangler config
steps.zh: 用 workspace 混入包住你的 Durable Object

steps.en: The Durable Object keeps the workspace in its own SQLite storage — durable across restarts
steps.zh: 把 workspace 存进 DO 自己的 SQLite，重启不丢

steps.en: Open it from your Worker and write a file through the fs API
steps.zh: 从 Worker 打开 workspace，写入一个文件

steps.en: Register an execution backend for commands
steps.zh: 注册一个执行后端来跑命令

steps.en: Run a command against the same files through the single exec entry point
steps.zh: 通过唯一的 exec 入口跑一条命令

steps.en: Executes it in the chosen backend and streams stdout/stderr/exitCode back live
steps.zh: 在后端里执行，实时回传 stdout／stderr／exitCode

value.en: Your agent gets a working directory that outlives restarts plus one exec API to work on it — no sandbox fleet, no sync glue of your own
value.zh: agent 得到一个活得比重启更久的工作目录，加一个能在上面干活的 exec 入口——沙箱机群和同步胶水都不用你管
